en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Hajjal, from Sa’alba who said,
‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘For everyone is an enthusiasm, and every enthusiasm has a decline. So ‘Tuba’ (a tree in the Paradise) is for the one whose nature was to goodness’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from al-Hajjal from Tha’labah who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘Everyone has an enthusiasm and every enthusiasm has a decline. Tuba (a tree in paradise) is for those whose decline is toward a constructive side.’”
